title: 4 Runners vs Rising Water! Who Escapes the Maze? 🌊
description:
Which runner escapes the flood? Call it before the water rises!

Four runners start in the same bottom cell of one maze, and the only way out is a gap in the top wall. Every runner moves exactly one cell per tick and follows one rule: yellow (triangle) keeps a hand on the left wall, pink (square) keeps a hand on the right wall, lime (diamond) always takes the unexplored branch that points closest to the exit, and violet (cross) takes a random unexplored branch at every junction. Lime and violet remember where they have been and back out of dead ends; the wall followers just never let go of their wall. Meanwhile the water rises row by row and keeps speeding up, and the countdown at the top shows from the first frame when it will reach the top. A runner is out the moment the water covers the middle of its cell. The first runner through the exit wins. Each runner's card shows its height above the water and how many steps the shortest route to the exit still needs.
The maze, the water timing and every move come from seed 80; the close race comes from searching seeds for one, not from editing the run. Picture and sound are generated by code, with no footage, samples or stock media.
Which rule would you bet on?
#simulation #satisfying #maze
pinned_comment: Left wall, right wall, nearest the exit or random: which runner gets out first? 🟡 🩷 🟢 🟣 Pick before the water reaches the second row.
synthetic_media_disclosure_reason: Clearly stylized 2D animation of abstract shapes; nothing realistic that could be mistaken for real people, places or events.

winner_distribution.note: rule of each color: YELLOW = LEFT WALL, PINK = RIGHT WALL, LIME = NEAREST THE EXIT, VIOLET = RANDOM
